basic_details.short_information: The official notification does not specify the application fee.

age_limit.age_details: Maximum 50 years for direct recruitment; not applicable to promotion/absorption (as on 1 May 2027)

qualification.details: Qualification: (i) Certificate of competency as Master of Foreign going ship issued by the Ministry of Shipping, Govt of India or an equivalent qualification recognised by the Ministry of Shipping, Govt. of India; (ii) Pilot license and experience of 10 years either or in Piloting or cumulative. Experience: Experience of 10 years either or in Piloting or cumulative. For absorption: officers holding analogous posts or the post of Dy. Conservator in Category-II ports or Harbour Master in Category-I Ports in the scale of pay of Rs. 43200-66000 with 2 years regular service in the grade, or officers holding posts of Harbour Master in the scale of pay of Rs. 36600-62000 with 4 years regular service in the grade in a Major Port Trust Age limit: Maximum 50 years for direct recruitment; not applicable to promotion/absorption (as on 1 May 2027) | Other conditions: | Open only to eligible officers of Major Port Authorities Applications must be forwarded with the prior approval of the Competent Authority

how_to_apply: Apply through the Online Application Portal (OAP) of the Ministry of Ports, Shipping and Waterways at http://onlinevacancy.shipmin.nic.in; any other mode is not accepted.
Get the hard copy of the OAP application forwarded through the proper channel with prior approval of the Competent Authority.
Enclose ACRs/APARs, Proforma (Annexure II), Undertaking (Annexure III), Vigilance Clearance (Annexure IV) and Port certificate (Annexure V).
Send it in an envelope superscribed "Application for the post of Deputy Conservator in JNPA".
Address it to The General Manager (Administration) & Secretary, Jawaharlal Nehru Port Authority, Administration Building, Sheva, Navi Mumbai – 400 707.
Application and documents must reach JNPA on or before 18 December 2026.
important_instructions: Post to be filled under the Jawaharlal Nehru Port Trust Employees (Recruitment, Seniority and Promotions) Regulations, 2011, as amended on 26 August 2020 Crucial date for qualification, experience and age is 1 May 2027

content_sections.heading: Eligibility Criteria
content_sections.text: Qualification: (i) Certificate of competency as Master of Foreign going ship issued by the Ministry of Shipping, Govt of India or an equivalent qualification recognised by the Ministry of Shipping, Govt. of India; (ii) Pilot license and experience of 10 years either or in Piloting or cumulative. Experience: Experience of 10 years either or in Piloting or cumulative. For absorption: officers holding analogous posts or the post of Dy. Conservator in Category-II ports or Harbour Master in Category-I Ports in the scale of pay of Rs. 43200-66000 with 2 years regular service in the grade, or officers holding posts of Harbour Master in the scale of pay of Rs. 36600-62000 with 4 years regular service in the grade in a Major Port Trust Age limit: Maximum 50 years for direct recruitment; not applicable to promotion/absorption (as on 1 May 2027) Other conditions: Open only to eligible officers of Major Port Authorities Applications must be forwarded with the prior approval of the Competent Authority

content_sections.heading: Who Cannot Apply for JNPA Recruitment 2026
content_sections.text: Applications submitted through any mode other than the OAP will not be accepted Advance copy not considered unless forwarded application is received within 15 days after the closing date

content_sections.heading: Pay and Terms of Engagement
content_sections.text: Post due to fall vacant on a regular basis with effect from 1 May 2027 Selected officer to be relieved from present post within 30 days of appointment Probation: N.A. as per the Schedule

content_sections.heading: How Will JNPA Select Candidates?
content_sections.text: Composite method of recruitment: promotion/transfer on absorption from eligible officers of Major Port Authorities Selection by merit, with benchmark in overall grading in the ACRs not below Very Good Selection by the Service Selection Committee Selection is by merit; benchmark in overall grading in the ACRs will not be below Very Good

content_sections.heading: Documents to Enclose
content_sections.text: Attested photocopies of ACRs/APARs for the last five years, each page attested by an officer not below Head of Department Proforma with attested copies of certificates of educational and other qualifications (Annexure II) Undertaking from the applicant in the prescribed format (Annexure III) Administrative and Vigilance Clearance in the prescribed format (Annexure IV) Recent passport size photographs on the Proforma

content_sections.heading: How to Apply for JNPA Recruitment 2026 Online
content_sections.text: Apply through the Online Application Portal (OAP) of the Ministry of Ports, Shipping and Waterways at http://onlinevacancy.shipmin.nic.in; any other mode is not accepted. Get the hard copy of the OAP application forwarded through the proper channel with prior approval of the Competent Authority. Enclose ACRs/APARs, Proforma (Annexure II), Undertaking (Annexure III), Vigilance Clearance (Annexure IV) and Port certificate (Annexure V). Send it in an envelope superscribed "Application for the post of Deputy Conservator in JNPA". Address it to The General Manager (Administration) & Secretary, Jawaharlal Nehru Port Authority, Administration Building, Sheva, Navi Mumbai – 400 707. Application and documents must reach JNPA on or before 18 December 2026.

faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to apply for JNPA Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The last date is 18 December 2026.

faq.question: Q2. How many vacancies are there in JNPA Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: There is 1 vacancy for Deputy Conservator.

faq.question: Q3. How do I apply for JNPA Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: Apply online through the link in the Important Links table, on or before 18 December 2026.

faq.question: Q4. What is the age limit for this recruitment?
faq.answer: The maximum age is 50 years for direct recruitment; not applicable to promotion/absorption (as on 1 May 2027).

faq.question: Q5. What is the salary for this recruitment?
faq.answer: Pay scale ₹1,00,000–2,60,000 (Head of Department level).

faq.question: Q6. What qualification is needed for this recruitment?
faq.answer: Certificate of competency as Master of Foreign going ship issued by the Ministry of Shipping, Govt of India or equivalent recognised qualification; Pilot license and 10 years' experience. Open to eligible officers of Major Port Authorities by absorption through the composite method.

faq.question: Q7. Are there other conditions for this recruitment besides qualification and age?
faq.answer: Yes. Open only to eligible officers of Major Port Authorities. Applications must be forwarded with the prior approval of the Competent Authority.

faq.question: Q8. Who cannot apply for this recruitment?
faq.answer: Applications submitted through any mode other than the OAP will not be accepted. Advance copy not considered unless forwarded application is received within 15 days after the closing date.

faq.question: Q9. How will candidates be selected for this recruitment?
faq.answer: Composite method of recruitment: promotion/transfer on absorption from eligible officers of Major Port Authorities. Selection by merit, with benchmark in overall grading in the ACRs not below Very Good. Selection by the Service Selection Committee. Selection is by merit; benchmark in overall grading in the ACRs will not be below Very Good.

faq.answer: Post due to fall vacant on a regular basis with effect from 1 May 2027. Selected officer to be relieved from present post within 30 days of appointment. Probation: N.A. as per the Schedule.
